availability.note: cadillacanz.com returned 403 to WebFetch on the research date (a curl attempt was refused by a permission check and not retried), so the manufacturer configurator could not be opened. Availability rests on The Beep's live per-state drive-away listing for the Sport AWD (Vic $86,136, with a recent price-history change), CarsGuide's price pages listing the Sport for MY26 and an MY27 row at $80,000, and CarsGuide's 30 Aug 2026 review of a customer-spec car. Single grade confirmed by CarExpert and CarsGuide.

listPrice.note: CarExpert: '$80,000 before on-road costs' in words, single Sport grade. Re-checked on research date: CarsGuide review (30 Aug 2026) 'A$80,000 MSRP, before on-road costs'; CarsGuide price page MSRP $80,000 for MY26 and MY27. Manufacturer site 403. The Beep's Vic drive-away $86,136 sits ~$1,900 above the app's computed $84,240, consistent with an $80,000 list plus dealer delivery. Intro $85,000 drive-away offer (1 Aug-31 Oct 2026) has expired.

batteryKwh.note: usable: ADAC 75.0 kWh netto / 79.0 brutto; EV Database 75.0 usable / 79.0 gross; Green NCAP 75.0 net / 80.6 installed. Australian car uses the same 75 kWh European-spec pack (CarExpert).

rangeKm.note: CarExpert 425 km WLTP for the Australian Sport; matches ADAC and EV Database WLTP for the European 21-inch Premium Sport. Australian grade rides on 21-inch wheels.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: WLTP 19.9 kWh/100km (Green NCAP declared, ADAC, CarExpert). Wall-to-wheel figure; usable battery/range gives 17.6, 13% lower, within tolerance.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: VDA to the cover (ADAC 'normal' 443 L; EV Database 443 L; German reviews cite Cadillac's 443 L plus a 61 L underfloor bin). Australian sources quote 744 L, which matches the US SAE to-the-roof 26.3 cu ft figure, so it is not used. No frunk.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: ADAC labels 1,340 L 'dachhoch' (to the roof) with seats folded; no belt-line figure found, so this overstates the cargo-cover convention. Australian 1,603 L is the US SAE figure.

seats.note: ADAC Sitzplätze 5; The Beep and CarsGuide list 5 seats.

towKg.note: ADAC Anhängelast gebremst 680 kg; EV Database 680 kg; CarsGuide Australian Sport page 680 kg braked.

warrantyYears.note: 5 years/unlimited km, no servicing condition; battery 8 years/160,000 km.

insuranceAnnual.note: kept at 2500: between bmw-ix1 xDrive30 M Sport ($77,900, $2,100) and polestar-4 dual motor ($81,750, $2,550), below cadillac-lyriq ($90,000, $2,850); new-brand parts uncertainty argues for the upper end.

depreciationCurve.note: Brand curve for all Cadillac rows chosen as [1,0.66,0.54,0.45,0.38,0.32]: the held cadillac-vistiq curve, one step from the held Optiq curve (0.33 at year 5), and shared with volvo-ex40. Steeper than mainstream for a new brand with thin local volume, no published resale data, and a $32,000 permanent Lyriq list cut in June 2026 (CarExpert 9 Jun 2026).

lowConfidence: cadillac-optiq-sport-awd.availability: manufacturer configurator (cadillacanz.com) returned 403; availability rests on third-party listings and reviews
